wikiGoal: A code wiki for this repository.

pages.title: Agent Runtime Architecture
pages.purpose: Describe the CLI-to-Agent architecture, backend split, message representations, lifecycle ownership, and the boundaries among prompts, tools, memory, MCP, skills, autonomy, and terminal UI.
instructions: Use Mermaid diagrams for the runtime/component flow.

pages.title: On-Demand Code Graph
pages.purpose: Explain the deferred code_graph tool, source discovery and Tree-sitter parsing, SQLite schema/cache lifecycle, relationship and impact queries, local FTS fallback, optional semantic/hybrid search, and metadata-only cloud-embedding consent boundary.
instructions: Use Mermaid diagrams for graph indexing, cache refresh, and search-mode flows.

pages.title: Conversation Context and Persistent State
pages.purpose: Explain system-prompt composition, project instructions and rules discovery, memory recall/prefetch, four-tier context reduction, large-result storage, token/cost limits, session persistence, and the distinct on-disk locations and invariants.
instructions: Use Mermaid diagrams for context lifecycle and persistence flows.

pages.title: Skills and Subagents
pages.purpose: Describe discovery precedence, frontmatter and supporting-file constraints, safe skill mutation and ownership, inline versus fork execution, background skill review, built-in/custom subagent configuration, tool scoping, and inherited runtime/permission behavior.
instructions: Use Mermaid diagrams for forked-agent and skill-review lifecycles.

pages.title: Tool Contracts and Safety Controls
pages.purpose: Document built-in and deferred tool activation, read-before-edit and mtime invariants, bounded outputs, permission-rule precedence, permission modes, dangerous shell confirmation, plan-mode restrictions, and Auto Mode classification boundaries.
instructions: Use Mermaid diagrams for non-trivial permission and tool-control flow.

pages.title: MCP Tool Integration
pages.purpose: Document MCP config-source merge order, stdio JSON-RPC connection and handshake, prefixed tool discovery/routing, lazy initialization, timeouts, partial connection failures, and shutdown cleanup.
instructions: Use Mermaid diagrams for the JSON-RPC connection and tool-routing sequence.

pages.title: Model Provider Integration
pages.purpose: Specify Anthropic and OpenAI-compatible client selection, streaming/message-format adaptation, thinking support, retry policy, cache accounting, side queries, token/cost accounting, API configuration, and provider failure behavior.
instructions: Use Mermaid diagrams for dual-backend request flow.

pages.title: Configuration and Runtime Operations
pages.purpose: Consolidate install and invocation surfaces, environment-file precedence, API and embedding settings, project/user .claude configuration, MCP configuration, local state directories, supported platform behavior, and the scheduled OpenWiki update workflow.

pages.title: Verification Strategy
pages.purpose: Map unit and integration commands to the Python test suites, explain SDK-dependent test skips and isolated fixtures, identify high-risk behavioral contracts covered by autonomy, skills, and code-graph tests, and distinguish stale TypeScript script references from available test surfaces.

pages.title: Agent Turn and Tool Execution
pages.purpose: Trace a normal user request through prompt assembly, streaming model calls, tool-call processing, permissions, early/concurrent execution, result persistence, message updates, budgets, retries, aborts, and session save for both provider protocols.
instructions: Use Mermaid diagrams for the request/control flow.

pages.title: Planning, Goals, Loops, and Auto Mode
pages.purpose: Cover REPL commands and the distinct control paths for plan approval, goal evaluation, periodic/dynamic loops, interrupt handling, schedule_wakeup scope, and the two-stage fail-closed Auto Mode classifier.
instructions: Use Mermaid diagrams for mode transitions and autonomous-control flow.
